cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll make this cottage ours. We wanted a place we knew every inch of.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know every tile. I'll get the quotes; you can choose who does it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Even the cheapest might take all our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll read the figures together before we sign. If we do spend them, I want us sitting under a roof we chose, not saving for someone else's home.

reason: Let A lead quotes but give B choice and a joint financial decision; expand the old belonging hope to intentional shared investment rather than deny the cost.
